context: Main eval weighted explicit review: non-overlapping Java 24 remote-call review; parallelStream is a weak answer for blocking remote calls and Java 24 stream guidance should recommend bounded Gatherers.mapConcurrent.

checklist.name: Preserves required output behavior

checklist.description: Recommends a Java 24 Gatherers.mapConcurrent stream chain with an explicit concurrency bound for the blocking fraud-screening calls.

checklist.name: Shows a safe stream chain
checklist.description: Describes or sketches carrying each Payment with the fraud-screening result using a non-null holder, filtering by that result, mapping back to Payment, sorting by submittedAt, and collecting with toList.
